'''Joe Radi''' was a [[Shadow Squadron]] member (Shadow 76) of the [[Players Committee]], listed at St. Louis, MO on the 3 December 2005 roster.<ref name="vol20051203">[https://web.archive.org/web/20051203064943/http://www.swccgpc.com/volunteers.htm Shadow Squadron], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 3 December 2005)</ref>

In May 2006 [[Nick Kolnik]] wrote that he believed Radi had run the 2005 Missouri State Championship, which a player recalled as held in St. Louis.<ref name="pcf-9759-137136">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=137136#137136 Missouri States], Nick Kolnik, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (17 May 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618095105/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=139408&highlight= Internet Archive]</ref>
